verification_report.summary: The complete proof is correct under the stated assumptions and accepted inputs. The pointwise torsion estimate has the correct positivity and normalization: dc=i/(4pi)(bar-partial minus partial) gives df wedge dc f=i/(2pi) partial f wedge bar-partial f. Every surviving diagonal-frame torsion monomial has derivative index outside I, and the corresponding lambda_I |f_a|^2 terms occur in the positive mixed gradient form. Young's inequality supplies C/delta and C delta uniformly for every delta>0. Both Stokes identities have the stated positive torsion remainder. Using d eta=d omega, differentiation of T gives coefficient n, while differentiation in R_k gives exactly k-1 and n-k; the resulting indices J_{k-2}, J_{k-1}, M_{k-2}, M_{k-1} are correct. All nonexistent terms are omitted. The two parameter choices are compatible: delta=K/p with fixed sufficiently large K gives pJ<=aM_0+(b/p)S, where S=sum_{k=0}^{n-2}M_k; delta=1/p gives M_k<=D(M_{k-1}+M_{k-2}+pJ), with D independent of p. Explicitly, B_{-1}=0, B_0=1 and B_k=D(B_{k-1}+B_{k-2}+1) give M_k<=B_k(M_0+pJ). The finite sum H of these B_k is independent of p, so substitution yields pJ<=(a+bH)M_0+bH J for p>=1. Taking p>=max(1,2bH) closes the absorption. The chain-rule factor p^2/4 then proves the gradient estimate. For n=1, T=1 and all torsion sums are empty; for n=2, S=M_0 and no recurrence is needed. The fixed volume normalization changes only Sobolev constants. Iterating with p_j=p_0 beta^j gives a convergent product P and the claimed integral inequality with C_1>=max(1,P^{p_0}). With A=log(2C_1)/p_0, its normalized integral implies mu({u<=m+A})>=1/(2C_1). Since sup u=0 makes -u nonnegative, the accepted normalized L1 bound yields -m<=A+2C_1 C_0, including the separate case -m<A. Connectedness is used through that accepted L1 input. The historical attribution was checked after arXiv theorem search using the supplied source and [TW10, Section 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0910.1390). Its convention corresponds to phi=u/(2pi) and exponent q=2pi p; its gradient and C0 estimates were not imported. The finite recurrence was verified independently of its different induction. No uniform mass bound over all potentials, BMP, PVP, uniform positive lower density, closedness, higher-order estimate, or existence assertion enters this audit. There are no critical errors or gaps.
